summary: Domain-validated guidance for planning, reviewing, and troubleshooting fMRI preprocessing, including motion and distortion correction, slice timing, registration, normalization, smoothing, confounds, and quality control for task, resting-state, and MVPA workflows.
use_when: choose motion correction slice timing normalization or smoothing settings
adapt preprocessing for task fMRI resting-state or MVPA
avoid_when: Acquisition metadata needed to select distortion and timing corrections are unavailable
A software-specific command reference is required instead of a methodological preprocessing plan
The requested operation is downstream statistical modeling rather than preprocessing
